logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the WO-03 independent verification memo. A single horizontal bar chart on a stated 0-50 Wh axis shows measured energy per acceptance batch for all four candidates in ascending order: P3 10 Wh (leader, highlighted), P2 22 Wh, P1 28 Wh, P4 49 Wh. Bar lengths are drawn proportional at 14.8 px per Wh so proportions are checkable against printed values. A dashed guide marks the leader's bar end; gap annotations +12 Wh, +18 Wh and +39 Wh label distances to P2, P1 and P4. Each row label carries recomputed quality and defect values. A bottom panel restates verification status: all four gates PASS (quality at least 80, defects at most 5), the energy ranking, and the ballot P3 as lowest-energy qualifying package. Every label serves the verification analysis; no decorative elements.
